gizmo.title: Nkhani yanthambi
gizmo.description: Nkhani yomwe chisankho chilichonse chimatsogolera ku chochitika ndi mathero osiyana. Ophunzira angabwerere ndi kuyesa njira zina; mathero ofikiridwa amakhazikitsa zigoli.

configure.title: Mutu
configure.description: Dzina la nkhaniyo, lowonetsedwa pamutu pake.

configure.title: Chochitika choyambira
configure.description: ID ya chochitika chomwe ophunzira amayambira. Siyani chopanda kanthu kuti muyambe pa chochitika choyamba.

advanced.title: Mtundu wowonetsa
advanced.description: Mtundu wosankha wa chizindikiro cha pamutu, mabatani ndi m'mbali mwa chisankho.
